title: UEFA Euro 2012 squads - Wikipedia
content: The following is a list of squads for each national team competing at the Euro 2012 in Poland and Ukraine. The tournament started on 8 June 2012 and the final took place in Kyiv on 1 July 2012. On 2 May 2012, Smuda named a provisional list of 23 players for the tournament, along with a seven-man reserve list.
